items.exampleEn: Some fruit goes bad in transit from farm to shop.
items.exampleZh: 有些水果在從農場運到商店的途中就壞了。

items.exampleEn: Our travel agent sent us a detailed itinerary.
items.exampleZh: 旅行社寄給我們一份詳細的行程表。

items.exampleEn: After skiing, we relaxed in the hotel sauna.
items.exampleZh: 滑完雪後，我們在飯店的三溫暖裡放鬆。

items.exampleEn: The company chartered a plane to take staff to the meeting.
items.exampleZh: 公司包了一架飛機，載員工去開會。

items.exampleEn: The canoe was made from a single tree.
items.exampleZh: 這艘獨木舟是用一整棵樹做成的。

items.exampleEn: She is nervous about her first transatlantic flight.
items.exampleZh: 她對自己第一次橫越大西洋的飛行感到緊張。

items.exampleEn: Drivers honked when the bus stopped in the middle of the road.
items.exampleZh: 公車停在馬路中間時，駕駛們紛紛按喇叭。

items.exampleEn: Scientists sent an unmanned boat to study the ice.
items.exampleZh: 科學家派出一艘無人駕駛的船去研究冰層。
items.glossZh: 無人駕駛的；無人操作的

items.exampleEn: The mountaineer reached the top before sunrise.
items.exampleZh: 那位登山家在日出前登上了山頂。

items.sentenceEn: Please check the itinerary before we leave for the airport.
items.sentenceZh: 我們出發去機場前，請先確認行程表。

items.audioEn: When you get here, just honk and I will come down.
items.audioZh: 你到了就按個喇叭，我會下樓。
items.questionZh: 說話者要對方到了之後做什麼？

items.sentenceEn: She works on ships that make transatlantic trips.
items.sentenceZh: 她在往返大西洋兩岸的船上工作。

items.sentenceEn: A taxi honked loudly outside the hotel at midnight.
items.sentenceZh: 午夜時，一輛計程車在飯店外大聲按喇叭。

items.stemEn: The airport has a quiet area where passengers in ____ can rest.
items.stemZh: 機場有一處安靜的區域，讓過境旅客休息。

items.stemEn: The boat can be ____ for weddings and birthday parties.
items.stemZh: 這艘船可以包租來辦婚禮和生日派對。

items.passageEn: Last month, Ken planned a business trip to Norway for his team. He prepared a careful itinerary, chartered a small boat to visit a fishing company, and booked a hotel with a sauna. The trip began badly: their bags were delayed in transit, and a long line of taxis honked outside the airport while they waited. However, the visit itself went well. On the last day, a famous mountaineer gave a talk about teamwork, and the team watched an unmanned aircraft take photos of the coast. Later, Ken checked the hotel invoice before paying.
items.passageZh: 上個月，Ken 為團隊安排了一趟到挪威的出差。他準備了周詳的行程表，包了一艘小船去拜訪一家漁業公司，還訂了一間有三溫暖的飯店。旅程一開始很不順：他們的行李在運送途中延誤了，等候時，機場外一長排計程車不停按喇叭。不過，拜訪本身很順利。最後一天，一位知名的登山家演講談團隊合作，團隊也看到一架無人駕駛的飛機拍攝海岸。之後，Ken 在付款前核對了飯店的帳單。

questions.questionZh: 旅程一開始遇到什麼問題？
options: 他們的行李在運送途中延誤了

questions.questionZh: 最後一天團隊看到了什麼？
options: 一長排計程車在機場外按喇叭
漁業公司的員工在港口捕魚
一艘從挪威開往日本的大船

items.promptZh: 我們搭獨木舟順著河流往下游去。
referenceEn: We went down the river by canoe.
We took a canoe down the river.
rubricZh: canoe 是名詞，表示「獨木舟」（例如 by canoe、in a canoe 等）
「往下游」可寫，例如 down the river、downstream 等

items.promptZh: 我們的行程很緊湊，每天都會參觀三個景點。
referenceEn: Our itinerary is very tight; we visit three places every day.
We have a busy itinerary, with three sights to see each day.
rubricZh: 「行程」用 itinerary（例如 our itinerary、a busy itinerary 等）
「很緊湊」可寫，例如 very tight、busy、packed 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：事實疑誤："The first transatlantic flight took over 33 hours." 第一次不著陸橫越大西洋（Alcock 與 Brown，1919）約 16 小時；33 小時多是 1927 年 Lindbergh 首次「單人」不著陸飛行。可查證事實寫錯（§11-21），建議刪去數字或改中性句。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改成不涉史實的 She is nervous about her first transatlantic flight.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似：mcq "We ____ a boat to take the whole team around the islands." 與單字卡 "The company chartered a plane to take staff to the meeting." 句型相同（charter 交通工具 to take 員工…）、情境相同（公司團體包交通工具），只換主詞與載具（§11-4）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 題幹改 The boat can be ____ for weddings and birthday parties.，代入後只有 chartered 成立

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：疑似："an unmanned train" 搭配不自然，載客列車一般說 driverless train；unmanned 多用於飛機、太空船、站點、船隻。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: unmanned 改用在 aircraft（無人機）：the team watched an unmanned aircraft take photos of the coast；第 2 小題同步改

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：題目要「你下一趟旅行的行程安排」，參考答案 "I always plan a simple itinerary before I travel." 是平常習慣，不是下一趟旅行（§11-17）。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 參考答案改成下一趟旅行：I am still planning the itinerary for my trip to the mountains next month.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B：transit mcq 寫具體簽證規定（§11.21）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 題幹改 The airport has a quiet area where passengers in ____ can rest.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B 疑似 12：canoe 卡與翻譯都是「我們划獨木舟」
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 卡改 The canoe was made from a single tree.

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關 B 疑似 13：閱讀末句硬塞 invoice、語意不順
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改 Later, Ken checked the hotel invoice before paying.；人名保留英文 Ken

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長第②③關裁示修正：第③關：評分要點有「可寫 X 等」沒有「例如」、「常用 X」或寫死位置、時態（§11.23）
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 依執行長裁示統一改成「例如…等」或「X 的用法，例如…等」：canoe 是名詞，表示「獨木舟」（例如 by canoe、in a canoe 等）／「往下游」可寫，例如 down the river、downstream 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 執行長最終複審修正：最終複審提醒 4：checked 譯「仔細核對」多了「仔細」
創辦人裁示：造句改翻譯：造句題（itinerary）原位換成翻譯題，沿用題 id c1-u29-l01-q18；目標字沿用 itinerary
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 改為 translate：promptZh「我們的行程很緊湊，每天都會參觀三個景點。」、hintWords ["itinerary"]、referenceEn ["Our itinerary is very tight; we visit three places every day.","We have a busy itinerary, with three sights to see each day."]、rubricZh ["「行程」用 itinerary（例如 our itinerary、a busy itinerary 等）","「很緊湊」可寫，例如 very tight、busy、packed 等","「景點」可寫，例如 places、sights 等"]（原 makeSentence：instructionZh「用 itinerary 造一個句子，說說你下一趟旅行的行程安排。」、referenceEn ["My itinerary for next summer includes three days in Tokyo.","I am still planning the itinerary for my trip to the mountains next month."]）
